item.title: US-Israel attacks: ‘We wont be silent’ — Iran President vows
item.description: Iranian President Masoud Pezeshkian has vowed that his country will not remain silent on the ongoing onslaught on the Islamic Republic. item.title: Nigerian Govt approves N48 billion to 12 selected universities
item.description: The Federal Government has approved N48b to 12 selected universities for engineering upgrades. Minister of Education, Dr. Tunji Alausa, made this disclosure on Monday at the inauguration of the Implementation Committee on Tertiary Education Trust Fund Special High-Impact Intervention Projects in Abuja. item.title: Iran: ‘We’re yet to get distress calls from Nigerians’ – FG
item.description: The Nigerians in Diaspora Commission, NiDCOM, says no distress call from Nigerians in Iran yet. NiDCOM stated this amid the ongoing crisis between Iran and the United States and its ally, Israel. DAILY POST recalls that the Federal Ministry of Foreign Affairs had said that it was still monitoring the situation in the Middle East. item.title: Fresh cult clash claims two lives in Lagos community
item.description: Two men suspected to be members of rival cult groups have been killed in a renewed outbreak of cult-related violence in the Ojo area of Lagos State. It was gathered that the incidents occurred on Sunday at separate locations within the community. The incidents were said to be linked to ongoing reprisals among rival factions. item.title: Nigerian gets 19-year jail term in US over $4m romance scam
item.description: A Nigerian national, Leslie Mba, has been sentenced to 19 years in a United States federal prison for his involvement in a large-scale romance fraud and business email compromise scheme that caused losses estimated at about $4 million. Mba, 40, who is not a U.S. citizen, is also expected to be placed in deportation proceedings […] Nigerian gets 19-year jail term in US over $4m romance scam

item.title: Popular photographer, Kola Onifoto dies in Lagos motorcycle crash
item.description: Popular Nigerian photographer and biker Orowole Kolapoz, widely known as Kola Onifoto, has died after a lone motorcycle crash in Lagos. Kolapoz, 32, a travel enthusiast and brand influencer, was reportedly involved in the accident on Sunday while embarking on what he described as his first solo motorcycle journey outside Lagos. item.description: Two children have lost their lives after drowning in a floodwater collection site on Erediauwa Street, off Sapele Road, in Ikpoba-Okha Local Government Area of Edo State. item.description: The National Industrial Court of Nigeria sitting in Kano has rejected separate ex parte applications seeking to restrain the Kano State Government from retrieving official vehicles from former commissioners who recently resigned from the State Executive Council.
